import re

def _flush(buf, bi, paras, pl):
    if buf:
        paras.append({'paragraph': len(paras) + 1, 'text': ' '.join(buf)})
        pl.extend(bi)
        del buf[:]
        del bi[:]

def parse(lines):
    paras = []
    pl = []
    codes = []
    cl = []
    links = {}
    ll = []
    buf = []
    bi = []
    incode = False
    code = []
    lang = ''
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.rstrip()
        if incode:
            cl.append(i)
            if s.strip().startswith('```'):
                codes.append({'example': len(codes) + 1, 'lang': lang, 'code': '\n'.join(code)})
                incode = False
            else:
                code.append(s)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^```\s*(\S*)', s)
        if m:
            _flush(buf, bi, paras, pl)
            incode = True
            code = []
            lang = m.group(1)
            cl.append(i)
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\[([^\]]+)\]:\s*(\S+)\s*$', s)
        if m:
            _flush(buf, bi, paras, pl)
            links[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
            ll.append(i)
            continue
        if not s.strip():
            _flush(buf, bi, paras, pl)
            continue
        buf.append(s.strip())
        bi.append(i)
    _flush(buf, bi, paras, pl)
    if incode:
        codes.append({'example': len(codes) + 1, 'lang': lang, 'code': '\n'.join(code)})
    blocks = []
    if paras:
        blocks.append({'name': 'paragraphs', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': pl, 'records': paras})
    if codes:
        blocks.append({'name': 'code_examples', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': cl, 'records': codes})
    if links:
        blocks.append({'name': 'links', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': ll, 'records': [links]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': []}
